description: List bookings (reservations). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/bookings. Filter by property, date range, changed-since, and status; opt into embedded charges/guest/tags. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

from.description: Start of the arrival/stay date window (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-07-01).

include_charges.description: Include the charges breakdown on each booking.

include_fields.description: Include the custom-fields collection on each booking.

include_guest.description: Include the embedded guest object on each booking.

include_tags.description: Include the tags collection on each booking.

limit.description: Max items to return per page (default set by OwnerRez, typically 10).

offset.description: Number of items to skip (for paging; combine with limit).

params.description: Additional documented query-string filters to send verbatim (merged with the typed params above).

property_ids.description: Comma-separated property id(s) to filter by, e.g. "123" or "123,456".

since_utc.description: Only bookings created/updated on or after this UTC timestamp (ISO-8601).

to.description: End of the arrival/stay date window (ISO-8601).

name: list_bookings
title: List bookings
